## Summary

Describe the change and the problem it solves.

## Validation

- [ ] Release build completed where applicable
- [ ] Relevant automated tests added or updated
- [ ] Existing tests pass

## Security impact

- [ ] No material security impact
- [ ] Authentication or session behavior changed
- [ ] Authorization, roles, or permissions changed
- [ ] Database access, SQL, migrations, or credentials changed
- [ ] Logging, audit, backups, imports/exports, or generated documents changed
- [ ] Cryptography, secrets, signing, dependencies, or supply-chain behavior changed
- [ ] Personal-data handling changed

If any security-impact item applies, describe the threat/abuse case considered, controls added or changed, tests/evidence, and any residual risk.

## Dependency impact

- [ ] No new/updated production dependency
- [ ] Dependency license reviewed
- [ ] Dependency maintenance/support status reviewed
- [ ] Vulnerability audit passes

## Compliance impact

State whether this change affects the security roadmap, threat model, data protection, business-record integrity, support policy, or compliance matrix. Update the relevant document when necessary.
